title: Normalized section models for affine upper-tail charts
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I → CommRingCat, c an affine limiting cone of R.op followed by Spec, i ≤ j, f:Xi → Spec R(i), and U an open cover of its j-base change with affine chart U(a) [def-pc-scheme], [def-pc-base-change], [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let M,N be quasi-coherent modules on U(a) [pqf-def-coherent]. Use the representative rep of the antisymmetrization of the upper tail j ≤ k, its initial class t, F = rep followed by upperTailChartDiagram.rightOp followed by global sections [new-affine-chart-upper-tail-limit-data], and the actual starting pullback section modules P,Q of the Lean statement. There are equivalences δM:P → Γ(M), δN:Q → Γ(N), a ring map ρ₀:colimit F → Γ(W₀(a)), and additive equivalences e₀M,e₀N from extension of scalars of P,Q to sections of the direct chart pullbacks. These are semilinear along ρ₀ and send 1 ⊗ m to the pullback of δ(m). The associated Hom equivalence α acts by conjugation with e₀M,e₀N on every section. At every x ≥ t there similarly exist ρₓ, eₓM,eₓN and β for the ordinary stage chart, with the same δM,δN, semilinearity, unit normalization and sectionwise conjugation formulas. The stage chart is affine. On the iterated chart V(a), with v:V(a) → W₀(a) and l:V(a) → Wₓ(a) the canonical lifts, the ring maps satisfy v.appTop(ρ₀(r₁(b))) = l.appTop(ρₓ(b)) for r₁ = colimit.ι F x. No compatibility for scalar extension of module morphisms is concluded.

proof.text: Obtain IsIso s, affineness of the limit chart, and its ring presentation ρ0 from affine_chart_section_ring_presentations. Apply affine_isomorphic_source_normalized_models once to s,M,N, obtaining fixed δM,δN and a model function H for every affine destination. Apply H to the limit chart using the ring compatibility from the first theorem. This constructs e0M,e0N and the four scalar and unit identities.

For x≥t, obtain ρx, affineness and the two ring compatibility identities from affine_chart_section_ring_presentations. Apply the same function H, hence with exactly the same δM,δN, to the stage chart and r=F(t→x). This gives exM,exN and their four identities. Forget invertibility of ρ0 and ρx to obtain the ring homomorphisms in the original conclusion.

Construct α and β from the already proved affine reconstruction Hom equivalence, using the private affine_hom_of_section_coordinates. A sheaf morphism is sent to eN.inverse composed with its top-section map composed with eM. Conversely conjugate a module morphism by eM.inverse and eN; surjectivity of the ring isomorphism gives linearity over the chart section ring. The affine Hom existence and uniqueness lemmas prove this function is bijective. Its inverse is the required Hom equivalence, and its inverse identity is precisely the required section formula. Package these Hom equivalences with the scalar models, the affine stage proof and the iterated-chart ring identity.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_chart_normalized_section_models
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    (a : U.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (U.X a))
    (M N : (U.X a).Modules)
    (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hNq : N.IsQuasicoherent)
    :
    let rep := (OrderEmbedding.ofAntisymmetrization
      (α := {k : I // j ≤ k})).monotone.functor
    let g := U.f a ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))
    let F := rep ⋙ (upperTailChartDiagram R j g).rightOp ⋙ Scheme.Γ
    let t := toAntisymmetrization (· ≤ ·) (⟨j, le_rfl⟩ : {k : I // j ≤ k})
    let B : (U.X a).Modules → ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj t) := fun L ↦ by
      let k := rep.obj t
      let r := Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE k.property))
      change ModuleCat.{u} Γ(pullback r g, ⊤)
      exact ModuleCat.of _ Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd r g)).obj L, ⊤)
    let P : ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj t) := B M
    let Q : ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj t) := B N
    let r₀ := (colimit.ι F t).hom
    let q₀ := baseChangeMap f
      (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
      (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
    ∃ (δM : (P : Type u) ≃ Γ(M, ⊤)) (δN : (Q : Type u) ≃ Γ(N, ⊤))
      (ρ₀ : ↑(colimit F) →+* Γ((U.pullback₁ q₀).X a, ⊤))
      (e₀M : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj P ≃+
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj M, ⊤))
      (e₀N : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q ≃+
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj N, ⊤))
      (α : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj P ⟶
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars r₀).obj Q) ≃
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj M ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj N)),
      (∀ b z, e₀M (b • z) = ρ₀ b • e₀M z) ∧
      (∀ b z, e₀N (b • z) = ρ₀ b • e₀N z) ∧
      (∀ m, e₀M ((1 : ↑(colimit F)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r₀] m) =
        pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q₀ a) M (δM m)) ∧
      (∀ m, e₀N ((1 : ↑(colimit F)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r₀] m) =
        pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q₀ a) N (δN m)) ∧
      (∀ s z, (α s).app ⊤ (e₀M z) = e₀N (s z)) ∧
      ∀ (x : Antisymmetrization {k : I // j ≤ k} (· ≤ ·)) (htx : t ≤ x),
        let k := (rep.obj x).val
        let hjk := (rep.obj x).property
        let q := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
          (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
          (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
            (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
        let p := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
        let q₀ := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
        let w : p ≫ q = q₀ := by
          rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
          congr 1
          ext
          simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op
        let r := (F.map (homOfLE htx)).hom
        let r₁ := (colimit.ι F x).hom
        let Uk : (pullback f (Spec.map
          (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q
        let V : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).OpenCover.{u} := Uk.pullback₁ p
        let v : V.X a ⟶ (U.pullback₁ q₀).X a := pullback.lift (V.f a)
          (Uk.pullbackHom p a ≫ U.pullbackHom q a)
          (by
            dsimp only [V]
            rw [Category.assoc, U.pullbackHom_map,
              ← Category.assoc, Uk.pullbackHom_map, Category.assoc, w])
        ∃ (ρₓ : ↑(F.obj x) →+* Γ((U.pullback₁ q).X a, ⊤))
          (eₓM : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ≃+
            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj M, ⊤))
          (eₓN : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q ≃+
            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj N, ⊤))
          (β : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ⟶
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q) ≃
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj M ⟶
              (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj N)),
          (∀ b z, eₓM (b • z) = ρₓ b • eₓM z) ∧
          (∀ b z, eₓN (b • z) = ρₓ b • eₓN z) ∧
          (∀ m, eₓM ((1 : ↑(F.obj x)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r] m) =
            pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q a) M (δM m)) ∧
          (∀ m, eₓN ((1 : ↑(F.obj x)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj t, r] m) =
            pullbackΓ (U.pullbackHom q a) N (δN m)) ∧
          (∀ s z, (β s).app ⊤ (eₓM z) = eₓN (s z)) ∧
          IsAffine (Uk.X a) ∧
          (∀ b, v.appTop (ρ₀ (r₁ b)) = (Uk.pullbackHom p a).appTop (ρₓ b))
